# #4034: Patch: every Field guide entry can be found in the lessons: The Coin when the opponent gets it, Tribes and Tribute from a lesson's deck
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The tutorial's Field guide lists 36 game mechanics, ticks each off as the player meets it, and shows how many are found. One entry can never be ticked: The Coin. It counts only when the player plays The Coin, but the player goes first in every lesson, so The Coin always goes to the tutorial opponent, which is not allowed to play it.

A player who finishes all five lessons still sees The Coin as "Waiting in lesson 5: The final exam", and the guide never reaches 36 of 36. Two more entries, Tribes and Tribute, need cards that no lesson deck holds, so a player finds them only if a random effect in the last lesson happens to deal one.

Once built, every entry can be found in the lessons, and a test keeps it that way.

## Why

**The Coin cannot be found**
- `apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts:329-334`: `the-coin` counts as found only when the human plays `core-t-coin`.
- Every lesson seats the human first: `humanSeat: "p1"` in all five of `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons/*.ts`.
- The tutorial spec says so too. `spec/09-architecture.md` (§9.10, line 190): "The human goes first in every lesson. Every other mechanic the Field Guide holds (… The Coin …) is met in play … and found".
- The opponent can never play it. It plays only the tutorial's own cards (R2533000; `is_tutorial_card` and `barred_from_play` in `crates/engine/src/state.rs:2457-2475`, which means Training Grounds only), and The Coin is a Core token.

**A test checks nothing**
- `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts:275`, "R291 seat the human second in the lesson that teaches The Coin", passes without testing anything: no lesson lists `the-coin` among its discoveries.
- This dates from #2444 (c663add229). It folded the old `advanced` lesson, which seated the human second and dealt Big Felinor, into the finale without a way to find these entries.

**Tribes and Tribute only by luck**
- Tribes (`discoveries.ts:346-353`) needs the human to play Legacy: Big Felinor (`traininggrounds-051`, Rare).
- Tribute (`discoveries.ts:356-361`) needs a card whose text says Tribute. The Training Grounds ones are Trigor (`traininggrounds-025`, Rare) and Legacy: The Rock (`traininggrounds-054`, Common).
- None of the five human decks holds any of them.

**The player sees the gap.** `apps/web/src/tutorial/FieldGuide.tsx:27` shows "{found} of {total} found", and `:55` shows "Waiting in lesson {number}: {title}".

## Proposal

- **The Coin.** Count it as found when the human's game shows The Coin going to either side: the public fact that the opponent goes second and gets The Coin, or an event that names it. Today only the human playing it counts. The check reads only the human's view and public events (R292, CLAUDE.md rule 7), and it keeps §9.10's "the human goes first in every lesson".
- **The R291 test.** Rewrite its Coin clause so it can fail: every lesson seats the human first, and the-coin's predicate fires on a view where the opponent gets The Coin.
- **Tribes and Tribute.** Put Big Felinor and one Training Grounds Tribute card into a lesson's human deck, in lesson 5 or wherever the theme fits. All three cards are Common or Rare, so R2205003's rarity limits allow any lesson. If the deal moves, re-pick that lesson's seed with `apps/web/scripts/lesson-deal.ts`, as `lessons/finale.ts`'s header comment describes.
- **A reachability test in `lessons.test.ts`.** Every Field guide entry that keys on one card, or on a card's text, must have such a card in some lesson's human deck, unless it reads a fact every lesson shows. It fails today on `the-coin`, `tribe` and `tribute`.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts`, `apps/web/src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts`, and the lesson file under `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons/` that takes the two cards (its seed too, if the deal moves).
- SPEC §9.10 (the tutorial and the Field Guide); R291, R292, R2205000, R2205003, R2533000

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A test view in which the opponent goes second with The Coin finds `the-coin`, and nothing the human cannot see is read.
- [ ] Some lesson's human deck holds Big Felinor and a Training Grounds Tribute card. The lesson tests (R291's decks, R2205003's limits, R2533001) still pass, and the lesson's seed still wins in its turns.
- [ ] The new reachability test fails on today's tree and passes after the change.
- [ ] The R291 Coin test asserts something that can fail.
- [ ] These pass: `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/tutorial` and `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`.

## Size and risks

Medium, about 4–5 files, client only, no engine change.

Risk: a new card in a lesson deck can shift that lesson's fixed deal, and with it a coach step that waits for a given turn. The lesson-deal script and the lessons' existing tests (`discovery-play.test.ts` plays the lessons) show whether it moved.

## Plan

_Written by `agy` (agy, `gemini-3.8-flash-high`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43793381644)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## 1. Goal
Ensure every Field guide entry (36 of 36) can be found in the tutorial lessons by updating `the-coin` discovery to be found when the opponent goes second and gets The Coin or when an event names it (reading only public view and events), adding Big Felinor (`traininggrounds-051`) and a Tribute card (`traininggrounds-054` Legacy: The Rock) to lesson 5's human deck to make Tribes and Tribute reachable, rewriting the R291 Coin test to assert the human goes first in all lessons and `the-coin` fires on a view where the opponent gets The Coin, and adding a reachability test asserting all entries keyed to specific cards or text exist in lesson human decks.

## 2. Files to touch
| Path | Status | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts` | `change` | Update `the-coin`'s `found` predicate to recognize when The Coin goes to either side (opponent gets it going second, or human gets it, or event names it) |
| `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons/finale.ts` | `change` | Replace two cards in `humanDeck` with `traininggrounds-051` (Big Felinor) and `traininggrounds-054` (Legacy: The Rock); preserve or update seed if deal shifts |
| `apps/web/src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts` | `change` | Add unit test under `describe("R2205000 the Field guide")` testing that a view showing the opponent going second with The Coin finds `the-coin` without reading hidden data |
| `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts` | `change` | Rewrite R291 test's Coin clause to assert human is first in all lessons and `the-coin` fires on a view where opponent gets The Coin; add reachability test for card/text-keyed discoveries |

**Must not touch:**
- Any file in `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `crates/ai/`, `crates/server/`, `crates/wasm/`

**Governing specs and rulings:**

- R291 (`spec/rulings/R0291.md`: tutorial lessons, fixed decks, human first, determinism)

- R2205000 (Field guide entries and discovery coach)
- R2205003 (Lesson decks and rarity limits: Training Grounds cards, showpieces only in lesson 5)
- R2533000 / R2533001 (Tutorial cards: Training Grounds only, barred rarities)

## 3. Steps
1. **Update `the-coin` predicate in [`apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4034/apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts):**
   In `FIELD_GUIDE`, locate the entry with `id: "the-coin"` (lines 329–334).
   Update `found` to check:
   ```ts
   found: (ctx) =>
     myPlays(ctx).some(({ event }) => event.defId === COIN) ||
     myHand(ctx.view).some((card) => card.defId === COIN) ||
     freshOf(ctx, "cardPlayed").some((event) => event.defId === COIN) ||
     freshOf(ctx, "addedToHand").some((event) => event.defId === COIN) ||
     (ctx.view.opponent.player === "p2" &&
       (freshOf(ctx, "addedToHand").some((event) => event.player === ctx.view.opponent.player) ||
         ctx.view.events.some((event) => event.type === "addedToHand" && event.player === ctx.view.opponent.player))),
   ```
   This ensures that when The Coin is dealt to the second player (`p2`) in setup/turn 1, or when an event or hand names The Coin, it is marked found, while reading only public view fields (`ctx.view.opponent.player`, `event.type`, `event.player`) and never reading hidden fields (`instanceId`, `defId`).

2. **Add unit test for `the-coin` discovery in [`apps/web/src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4034/apps/web/src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts):**
   In `describe("R2205000 the Field guide")`, add a test asserting that a test view in which the opponent goes second with The Coin (`addedToHand` for `p2` with hidden fields) finds `the-coin`, and that a view where the human has The Coin finds `the-coin`:
   ```ts
   it("R292 finds The Coin when the opponent goes second with it, and reads nothing hidden", () => {
     const view = baseView({
       viewer: "p1",
       opponent: emptySide("p2"),
       events: [{ type: "addedToHand", player: "p2", instanceId: "hidden", defId: "hidden" }],
     });
     expect(found(view, [])).toContain("the-coin");

     const freshEvent: GameEvent = { type: "addedToHand", player: "p2", instanceId: "hidden", defId: "hidden" };
     expect(found(baseView({ viewer: "p1", opponent: emptySide("p2") }), [freshEvent])).toContain("the-coin");

     const p2View = baseView({ viewer: "p2", you: emptySide("p2", { hand: [card({ defId: "core-t-coin" })] }) });
     expect(found(p2View, [])).toContain("the-coin");
   });
   ```

3. **Add Big Felinor and Legacy: The Rock to [`apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons/finale.ts`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4034/apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons/finale.ts):**
   In `lesson.humanDeck`, replace two cards that are already duplicated across other lessons (e.g. `"traininggrounds-008"` Clobberer and `"traininggrounds-043"` Legacy: Mr. Vanilla) with:
   - `"traininggrounds-051"` (Legacy: Big Felinor, Rare)
   - `"traininggrounds-054"` (Legacy: The Rock, Common)
   Keep the deck size at exactly 20 cards. Both cards are Common/Rare from Training Grounds, adhering to R2205003 and R2533000.
   Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/scripts/finale.test.ts`. If the test passes with the existing seed (`tg-finale-175`), keep it. If the deal shifted and `finale.test.ts` fails, use `pnpm --dir apps/web exec tsx scripts/lesson-deal.ts finale --scan tg-finale- 1 200` to find a seed where Seance is drawn in early turns and the coach line wins in <= 11 turns, update `lesson.seed`, and update the header comments.

4. **Rewrite R291 Coin test and add reachability test in [`apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4034/apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts):**
   - In `describe("R291 the tutorial's lessons")`, rewrite line 275:
     ```ts
     it("R291 seat the human first in every lesson, and find The Coin when the opponent gets it", () => {
       for (const lesson of TUTORIAL_LESSONS) {
         expect(lesson.humanSeat, lesson.id).toBe("p1");
       }
       const coin = discoveryById("the-coin");
       expect(coin, "the-coin discovery exists").toBeDefined();
       const view = baseView({
         viewer: "p1",
         opponent: emptySide("p2"),
         events: [{ type: "addedToHand", player: "p2", instanceId: "hidden", defId: "hidden" }],
       });
       expect(coin?.found({ view, legal: [], fresh: [], aiToAct: false }), "fires on view where opponent gets The Coin").toBe(true);
     });
     ```
   - Add the reachability test:
     ```ts
     it("every Field guide entry that keys on a card or card text can be found in some lesson's human deck", () => {
       const allHumanCards = TUTORIAL_LESSONS.flatMap((lesson) => lesson.humanDeck);
       const defs = allHumanCards.map((id) => def(id));

       // Entries keyed on specific cards:
       expect(allHumanCards, "lanes needs Midlane Menace (traininggrounds-005)").toContain("traininggrounds-005");
       expect(
         allHumanCards.some((id) => ["traininggrounds-022", "traininggrounds-006", "traininggrounds-007"].includes(id)),
         "adjacency needs a neighbour-rewarding card",
       ).toBe(true);
       expect(allHumanCards, "copying needs Seance (traininggrounds-037)").toContain("traininggrounds-037");
       expect(allHumanCards, "tribe needs Big Felinor (traininggrounds-051)").toContain("traininggrounds-051");

       // Entries keyed on card text:
       expect(defs.some((card) => card.base.text.includes("Cry:")), "cry needs a Cry card").toBe(true);
       expect(defs.some((card) => card.base.text.includes("Tribute")), "tribute needs a Tribute card").toBe(true);
       expect(defs.some((card) => card.base.text.includes("Aura:")), "aura needs an Aura card").toBe(true);
       expect(defs.some((card) => card.base.text.includes("Death:")), "death needs a Death card").toBe(true);
       expect(defs.some((card) => card.base.text.includes("random")), "random needs a card with random text").toBe(true);

       // Entry that reads a fact every lesson shows:
       const coin = discoveryById("the-coin");
       expect(coin, "the-coin exists").toBeDefined();
       const view = baseView({
         viewer: "p1",
         opponent: emptySide("p2"),
         events: [{ type: "addedToHand", player: "p2", instanceId: "hidden", defId: "hidden" }],
       });
       expect(coin?.found({ view, legal: [], fresh: [], aiToAct: false }), "the-coin is found from public setup events").toBe(true);
     });
     ```

## 5. Done when
- [ ] `the-coin`'s `found` predicate in `apps/web/src/tutorial/discoveries.ts` recognizes when The Coin goes to either side (public fact of opponent going second or event naming it) without reading hidden fields.
- [ ] `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons/finale.ts` holds `traininggrounds-051` (Legacy: Big Felinor) and a Tribute card (`traininggrounds-054` Legacy: The Rock) in its human deck (20 cards total).
- [ ] The R291 Coin test in `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts` is rewritten to assert human first in all lessons and `the-coin` fires on a view where opponent gets The Coin.
- [ ] The reachability test in `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons.test.ts` is added, fails on the baseline tree (missing coin, tribe, tribute), and passes with the change.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/tutorial/discovery.test.ts` passes.

## 6. Risks
- **Hidden information leak (CLAUDE.md rule 7, R292):** The client must never inspect hidden card identities (`instanceId: "hidden"`, `defId: "hidden"`). The coach predicate must only read public facts (`ctx.view.opponent.player === "p2"`, `event.player === ctx.view.opponent.player`, `event.type === "addedToHand"`). Avoid inspecting `event.defId` on opponent hand events.
- **Deal shift in Lesson 5 (R291, R293):** Substituting cards in `humanDeck` may change library ordering on a given seed. If Seance is drawn too late or the coach line takes > 11 turns, `finale.test.ts` will catch it. The builder mitigates this by replacing vanilla duplicates (`traininggrounds-008`, `043`) and, if needed, re-picking the seed using `lesson-deal.ts --scan`.
- **Rarity and set limits (R2205003, R2533000):** Both added cards must be Training Grounds cards (Common/Rare), keeping all 4 TG showpieces in lesson 5 and maintaining deck size at 20.

## 7. Open questions
None. All design requirements are settled by the issue and existing spec (§9.10, R291, R292, R2205000, R2205003, R2533000).
